id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

title:
Controller Type to update the {@link ExMachinaInstance#status} field for each instance so that it accurately
reflects the state of the underlying {@link ExMachina} service.

This is done by retrieving all ExMachina K8s Deployments and parsing their "status" fields. For more information
see [Deployment status](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/#deployment-status)

We persist a singleton instance to track the last time that the statuses were updated. This way we can avoid
updating statuses beyond a particular interval, which prevents overloading the {@link K8sApiServer} with requests.
It is a persistable entity type because it is more robust to store in it in Postgres, while the Config framework can
require manual cache invalidation.

The following approaches were considered during the design of this method:
1. Make API requests to individual services
   - Used in prior versions (e.g. v7). This approach is not scalable.
2. Use [K8s Watch API](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#efficient-detection-of-changes)
   - Uses long-polling, which can tie up threads. However, this can be used in tandem with current implementation.
3. Use [Container lifecycle hooks](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/container-lifecycle-hooks/)
   - Not robust or capable enough.
4. **[Chosen Implementation]** Use liveliness/readiness readings from K8s Deployment Statuses.
   - Most scalable, as we can rely on individual kubelets to accurately provide deployment statuses.
name: ExMachinaInstance.Status.Controller
